changeSet.author: Puneet Gupta
changeSet.sql:
create or alter function [dbo].[GetAssetTypeBreadcrumbs] ( @assetTypeUid uniqueidentifier ) returns table as return ( with h as ( select 0 as Level, Name, ID, ObjectID from AssetType where uid = @assetTypeUid
union all
select o.[Level]-1 as [Level], s.Name, s.ID, s.ObjectID from h o inner join IntersectType i on i.ObjectAssetTypeID = o.ID inner join [Predicate] P on P.ID = i.PredicateID and P.[Type] = 3 inner join AssetType s on s.ID = i.SubjectAssetTypeID ) select distinct top 1000000 h.Level, h.Name as TypeName from h order by h.Level )
changeSet.rollback:
create or alter function [dbo].[GetAssetTypeBreadcrumbs] ( @objectType varchar(max), @objectId int ) returns table as return ( with h as ( select 0 as Level, Name, ID, ObjectID from AssetType where [Object] = @objectType and ObjectId = @objectId
union all
select o.[Level]-1 as [Level], s.Name, s.ID, s.ObjectID from h o inner join IntersectType i on i.ObjectAssetTypeID = o.ID inner join [Predicate] P on P.ID = i.PredicateID and P.[Type] = 3 inner join AssetType s on s.ObjectID = i.SubjectAssetTypeID ) select distinct top 1000000 h.Level, h.Name as TypeName from h order by h.Level )
